verdict.rationale: Clerky provides its own controlled workflow for drafting startup legal paperwork. Users customize key terms in templated document sets and can swap the underlying forms. Collaborators are invited in real time, attorneys can review and comment, and every change to a document set is logged with attribution. However, the evidence covers only Clerky's own standardized startup documents (formations, safes, notes, equity); nothing shows counterparty negotiation or redline/tracked-changes markup of arbitrary contracts. Missing for 10: redlining/tracked changes, counterparty negotiation workflow, general contract drafting beyond Clerky's templated products, independent corroboration of the review workflow.
